description: Commands the Workbench can run. Every write asks first in a command card (.sy-cmd). The model can only propose them.

commands.name: scan.start
commands.label: Start a map scan
commands.effects: Starts a new scan on sandbox. Nothing in the portal model changes until the scan records pages.
commands.stop: Stop the scan at any time; pages recorded so far are kept.

commands.name: scan.resume
commands.label: Resume from last checkpoint
commands.effects: Starts a new scan that continues {scan} from the last good checkpoint. Its queued links carry over.
commands.stop: Not undoable; you can stop the new scan.

commands.name: scan.stop
commands.label: Stop the scan
commands.effects: Stops {scan}. Recorded pages and the queue are kept; you can resume later.
commands.stop: Not undoable; Resume continues from the last checkpoint.

commands.name: path.attempt
commands.label: Run an attempt
commands.api: POST /paths/{path}/attempts (the server finds the path from scan + step)
commands.effects: Replays to the checkpoint before step {step} and tries the action again with: {variation}.
commands.stop: Not undoable; attempts are listed and never overwrite each other.

commands.name: mark.add
commands.label: Add a mark
commands.effects: Marks the page for the next scan plan.
